methods: solving a linear equation in logs
statement: Solve the equation $3^{2x}=5^{x+1}$. Give your answer in exact form.
solution: Take natural logs: $2x\\ln 3=(x+1)\\ln 5$, so $x(2\\ln 3-\\ln 5)=\\ln 5$, giving $x=\\frac{\\ln 5}{2\\ln 3-\\ln 5}=\\frac{\\ln 5}{\\ln(9/5)}$. Numerically $x\\approx 2.929$.
